title: Normalized forgetting for prescribed native Hom representatives
statement: For a separated finite-type quasi-compact k0-scheme X, with k0 finite and l prime away from its characteristic, let M be any NativeClosedHomModels [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. There exists a natural derived isomorphism chi from M.weilHom followed by nativeForget to M.ordinaryHom applied to the forgotten variables, satisfying NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility for precisely the representative systems in M. Its chain comparison on K-injective pairs has the unsigned projection formula, and its derived representative square includes both localization factors. No tensor, adjunction or monoidal structure is assumed.

source.place: Native tensor model, Hom-comparison part of steps 2 and 3; Stacks 0A95, 08J7

proof.text: Take the standard native two-injective model. Compose each prescribed representative with the inverse row-sign isomorphism; conjugating row-sign naturality gives both-variable representative naturality.

source.place: Native tensor model, Hom-comparison part of steps 2 and 3; Stacks 0A95, 08J7

proof.text: Apply kInjectiveHomComparisonDescent to the rebased representatives and the existing chain comparison. Underlying native forgetting preserves K-injectives. This gives chi with its localized representative square.

source.place: Native tensor model, Hom-comparison part of steps 2 and 3; Stacks 0A95, 08J7

proof.text: Conjugate both ends of the chain comparison back by the row-sign isomorphisms. Apply conjugateLocalizationSquare to its derived equation and cancel inverse sign maps. On every product projection the two factors (-1)^(np) cancel, giving exactly the required compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem native_hom_representative_exists
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X) :
    ∃ χ : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom,
      NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
        (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
        M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
        (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) χ
